# Dammam Airport Taxi

> Private, fixed-fare taxi and chauffeur transfers from King Fahd International Airport (DMM) Dammam, across the Eastern Province, to Bahrain via the King Fahd Causeway, and to other GCC countries. Open 24/7. Booking by WhatsApp: +966 59 141 9157.

Website: https://dammamairporttaxi.com
Languages: English, Arabic
Service area: Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Jubail, Qatif, Ras Tanura, Al Ahsa/Hofuf, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, UAE, Riyadh and other Saudi cities.
Included: fixed price, meet & greet, flight tracking, 60-minute free waiting, King Fahd Causeway tolls on Bahrain routes.
Vehicles: Toyota Camry sedan (1-4), GMC Yukon SUV (1-6), Toyota Staria van (1-8), luxury.

## Key fares (SAR, sedan / SUV / van / luxury)
- Dammam to Bahrain: 400 / 550 / 700 / 1300 (about 85 km, 1.5-2 hours)
- Bahrain to Khobar: 300 | Dhahran: 350 | Dammam Railway: 400 | Dammam Airport: 450 | Qatif: 450 | Ras Tanura: 500 | Jubail: 550 | Tanajib: 700 | Al Hassa: 700 | Hofuf: 750 | Ras Al Khair: 800 | Khafji: 900 (sedan fares)

## Notes
Prices are fixed per route and vehicle. Visa fees and personal entry charges are not included. Entry requirements depend on nationality; check official government portals before travel.
